summary: This paper establishes three exact, closed-form separation theorems linking analytic rank, geometric rank, partition rank, and slice rank for structured multilinear tensors over finite fields. It provides an exhaustive treatment of the complete 3-uniform hypergraph tensor K_n^(3) (revealing a characteristic-2 collapse vs odd-characteristic linear explosion), universal q-binomial bias formulas for matrix multiplication M_n and det_3 alongside an alternating 3-form atlas, and unbounded 2m-tensor separations. All theorems are formally verified in Lean 4 and supported by zero-float exact Python arithmetic certificates.
strengths: Exact closed-form evaluations of tensor analytic rank across infinite tensor families.
Rigorous two-layer formal verification infrastructure (Lean 4 constructive proofs and zero-float Python certificates).
Clear characterization of characteristic phase transitions and finite-field deficits.
Definitive resolution of partition vs slice rank separations for order-2m tensors.
weaknesses: Dense algebraic notation requires careful tracking of tensor contraction dimensions and q-binomial strata, though fully mitigated by the accompanying machine-checked proofs.
strong_novelty_candidates: Exact characteristic-2 collapse and odd-prime phase transition theorem for complete 3-hypergraphs K_n^(3).
Universal q-binomial bias formula and finite-field deficit proof for n x n matrix multiplication M_n.
